postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Preserve any follow-up commands exactly.

postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Preserve any error details and follow-up commands exactly.

commands.readmeSummary: show doctor, sender, agents, and recent activity
postInstructions: Present the command output as a compact status view. Do not invent unavailable state.

commands.name: who

postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. If multiple agents share a short name, keep the fully-qualified handles visible.

commands.name: agents

commands.readmeSummary: list available agents and their routable handles
postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Prefer fully-qualified handles when the output shows ambiguity.

commands.name: latest
commands.description: Show recent Scout messages, flights, and broker activity
postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Preserve ids and refs exactly.

commands.name: inbox
commands.description: Show recent direct or addressed Scout messages for the current sender
commands.readmeSummary: show recent messages addressed to you
postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Preserve conversation and message ids exactly.

commands.name: channel
commands.description: Show recent Scout messages in a named channel
commands.readmeSummary: show recent messages in a named channel
postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Preserve conversation and message ids exactly.

commands.name: tell
commands.description: Tell a Scout agent or channel something (FYI, status, result) without asking for a reply
commands.readmeSummary: tell an agent or channel an FYI, status, or result; use /scout:ask for work or a reply
postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Do not reinterpret message body mentions as routing if the user passed `--to`, `--ref`, or `--channel`.

commands.name: ask
commands.description: Ask a Scout agent to own work and return durable flight info
commands.readmeSummary: ask an agent to own work and return durable flight info
postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Treat it as a durable broker receipt and flight record, not as a promise that the final answer has already arrived.

For fresh capability work, prefer `--project <path>` with optional `--harness <claude|codex>` over guessing a generic agent label. Use `--to` for a known target and `--ref` for returned continuity handles.
Preserve flight ids, refs, target labels, and acknowledgement or completion messages exactly.

Expect the target acknowledgement to appear quickly in the same Scout conversation. Expect completion or the final answer later in the same conversation, via notifications, or by polling/waiting according to the selected reply mode.

commands.name: broadcast
commands.description: Broadcast an explicit Scout announcement to channel.shared
postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Use this command only for messages genuinely intended for everyone.

commands.name: up
commands.description: Start or revive a Scout agent by name, handle, or project path
commands.readmeSummary: start or revive a Scout agent
postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Preserve any resolved agent identity or follow-up command exactly.

commands.name: ps
commands.description: Show local Scout-launched agent processes and session state
postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Preserve process/session ids and state labels exactly.

commands.name: open
commands.description: Open the Scout web UI for the current local broker
postInstructions: Present the command output as-is. Preserve the opened URL when Scout prints one.

commands.name: trace
commands.description: Show the Scout asks this session handed to agents (requires mods)
commands.readmeSummary: open this session's ask trace when mods are enabled
commands.notice: The Scout trace pane needs Claude Code >=2.1.287, or CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_FUNCTION_HOOKS=1 on an earlier build. Restart Claude Code with mods enabled to use /scout:trace.
postInstructions: Present the compatibility notice as-is. Do not claim that a trace pane opened.
